reason: The price is fine and the escrow and written warranty sound sensible, but the platform has just started with a few partners in Riyadh and Cairo. I would not hand my car to a shop I have never heard of until I see other owners say the work held up.
objection: If the film peels or the installer disappears after I have paid, who do I complain to, and does the held money or the warranty actually help me then? Nothing I have read tells me there is a real person or company behind the warranty.
would_change_my_mind: Reviews from several owners of cars like mine, and a named company that stands behind the warranty and the money held in escrow.
